capture.notes: Derived archive from live BTicino F461 (firmware 2.0.11 / WHO 1013 134.15.5.0) multi-session bus capture with physical F411/4 lighting actuator (WHERE 06, 07), F411/2 shutter actuator (WHERE 05, 5s travel time), and KW4691 thermostat (zone 2). Covers WHO 14 (Special commands: actuator lock *14*0*WHERE## and unlock *14*1*WHERE##) across lighting and automation actuators, command-session ACK vs 2.05s unpopulated bus timeout NACK, status-query/WHAT parser NACK boundaries, and #4#01 interface routing.
